t: # Short Obligatory Prayer ## To be recited once in twenty-four hours, at noon. Mi ta djula mi Gaan Gadu, taa Ju mbei mi fu sabi Ju, noo da I gaandi. Awaa mi ta konda taa me a kaakiti, I a taki a hii sembe liba, mi ta pena, noo I a gudu. Na wan kodo Gadu de boiti Ju, di Hepi-Man a fuka, di Seepi-Kiia-Wan.
